template: group_normalize(trade_when(abs(group_zscore(ts_corr({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, {owners_decile_rank_long}, 60), sector)) > 1.5, multiply(group_zscore(ts_corr({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, {owners_decile_rank_long}, 60), sector), add(1, multiply(0.5, ts_zscore(ts_delta(group_rank(ts_corr({of_owners_decile_rank_long}, {owners_decile_rank_long}, 60), sector), 21), 252)))), 0), sector)
idea: 仅在当前稳定性处于行业极端（|Z|>1.5）时开仓，避免中等区域噪音；开仓后根据过去21天稳定性排名的变化动量（其时序Z分数）动态调整仓位权重：若稳定性排名持续提升（动量为正），则加大多头暴露，反之亦然。最后通过group_normalize确保行业内多空市值中性，控制行业偏离风险。
expression_list: group_normalize(trade_when(abs(group_zscore(ts_corr(insd8_effective_number_of_owners_decile_rank_long, insd8_effective_number_of_owners_decile_rank_long, 60), sector)) > 1.5, multiply(group_zscore(ts_corr(insd8_effective_number_of_owners_decile_rank_long, insd8_effective_number_of_owners_decile_rank_long, 60), sector), add(1, multiply(0.5, ts_zscore(ts_delta(group_rank(ts_corr(insd8_effective_number_of_owners_decile_rank_long, insd8_effective_number_of_owners_decile_rank_long, 60), sector), 21), 252)))), 0), sector)
